text: I think you'll love this Rhubarb Dumplings recipe! It's a quick and easy dessert that fits within your typical cooking time of about 35 minutes. Although it doesn't feature any of your preferred ingredients like tapioca flour or soy sauce, it does include some sweet and comforting elements that might appeal to you. The use of brown sugar and cinnamon gives it a warm and inviting flavor, and the fact that it's gluten-free (I'm assuming based on the lack of gluten-containing ingredients) makes it a safe choice for you.
